fluff.overview: Reforms begun under Alessandro Steiner and reinforced by Federated Suns influence have integrated Lyran infantry into combined-arms operations more effectively than at any point in the Commonwealth's history. Foot infantry platoons form the backbone of the LCAF's garrison forces, deploying on foot to hold positions, patrol perimeters, and secure urban areas where vehicles cannot easily operate. Armed with heavy-caliber Zeus rifles and Firedrake support needlers, these platoons combine hard-hitting ballistic fire with flechette weapons that shred unarmored targets and can ignite terrain.
